versions.content: A reboot of the communication partner shall be detected based on consecutive Service Discovery messages (for communication partner; unicast and multicast separated) in the following two ways :  Reboot Flag change s from ‘0’ to ‘1’ or  Session ID does not increase, while Reboot Flag stays ‘1’ .
